title: story maps in the store, so every item sits in the bigger picture

criteria.text: Patton's structure as records: journey, activities, tasks, details, each knowing its parent
criteria.note: Kinds `journey`, `activity`, `task`, `detail` with `parent` and `place` (#1257) [V]. Checked: `[guards F132.1]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_maps.sql`.

criteria.text: Up and down in one call: any item returns its place, what sits around it and what it is made of
criteria.note: `knowledge.map_place` (#1257; every-department read #1343, #1350) [V]. Checked: `[guards F132.2]` in `tests/knowledge-maps.test.ts` and `supabase/tests/knowledge_maps.sql`.

criteria.text: Slices cut across the map: each task shows which slices include it and whether it is built
criteria.note: `slice_of` a journey, `takes`, `knowledge.built` (#1257; built from shipped state #1341, review recorded) [V]. Checked: `[guards F132.3]` in `tests/knowledge-maps.test.ts` and `supabase/tests/knowledge_maps.sql`.

criteria.text: Editing shows the picture: a proposed change returns the journey, slices and features it touches before it is decided
Where does this fit: a new idea in plain words returns the journey, activity and task, what it stands on, what must be built first, and what it clashes with
criteria.note: `fits` (#1257); for an unplaced idea it lists rules sharing its words as 'may clash, not judged yet', not a judged clash [V]. Checked: `[guards F132.5]` in `tests/knowledge-maps.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Today comes in: `uat-journeys.json` walk-throughs become journeys, each feature is placed, IMAGINE ideas are placed or marked "no journey yet"
criteria.note: `maps.ts` and `maps-seed.json`, ideas CO-0003 to CO-0043 placed (#1257; later ideas #1331) [V]. Checked: `[guards F132.6]` in `tests/knowledge-maps.test.ts`. Reviewed: #1331 carries no `Reviewed by:`, so no.

criteria.text: The first map is real: "a neighbour finds something happening this weekend and goes" loads with its activities, tasks, details and two slices
Short answers: each answer fits a phone screen, plain words, no ticket numbers
criteria.note: Every verb answers in twelve lines or fewer (#1257) [V]. Checked: `[guards F132.8]` in `tests/knowledge-maps.test.ts`.
